title: Bind behavioural test coverage and phase reviews to durable evidence
body:
## Outcome

Extend durable phase evidence so each work phase has a separately bound review record and test design proves behavioural coverage before implementation.

## Acceptance

Record phase output, execution selection, reviewer identity, review decision, reviewed input/output hashes, and immutable references. Model every goal acceptance behaviour as covered by a failing test or explicit justified exclusion. Reject implementation completion when required behaviour lacks coverage, the approved test design is stale, tests did not fail on baseline, or prescribed checks do not pass. Evidence and review records become stale when bound inputs change while byte-identical outputs remain reusable after reassessment. Cover parent/child evidence gates and independent reviewer requirements.
